## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-12:

- Reshaped the status report into an executive briefing plus a leadership meeting agenda that puts decisions before updates.
- Removed the connector section (project tracker, chat, calendar), the offer to post to a channel, the slash-command usage block and the reference to CONNECTORS.md.
- Replaced emoji status markers with green, amber and red words, and "ETA" with an expected date given by the owner, not a promise.
- Kept the report structure (headline, status, metrics, accomplishments, in progress, risks, decisions, priorities) in `references/brief-template.md`.
- Added rules against invented progress, privacy for personnel matters and a handoff section.
